palette.notes: Each stage has a strong colour key: blue-violet New York street, green tea house, orange sunset savanna, teal market. Fighters keep saturated costume colours (white gi, red gi, purple) that stand out on it; a parry flashes the fighter (wiki), a hit flashes pale blue.

lighting: Stages are lit like paintings with their own key colour (sunset orange, cool blue dusk); fighters get soft shading and a dark cast shadow ellipse under the feet that grounds them.
silhouette: Large fighters, about half the screen height, each a distinct shape: lanky, hulking, tiny and quick. Wide stances and long limbs read from the pose alone.

motion.timing: Smooth, many-drawing animation praised for clear personality (wiki); the sheet shows big arcs on kicks and jumps, knock-down poses, and long idle stances between hits. No frame timings measured.

texture: Hand-drawn sprites with soft shading; stages are busy and detailed (graffiti, signs, market stalls) with animated crowds standing around.
camera: Side-on two-shot that pans slightly to keep both fighters in view; big text cards (ROUND 1, FIGHT!) slam across the middle on a red band.
sound: House, jungle and drum and bass soundtrack; character themes remixed in later versions (wiki).

acting.enters: Each fighter is already in stance on their own stage when the ROUND 1 card slams in; intro poses play first (wiki).
acting.acts: Personality in idle stance, hit reactions and win poses: one bounces, one sways, one stands still. Crowds in the back react while the fight goes on.
acting.exits: The loser falls and stays down; the winner holds a victory pose and a grade follows (wiki).
acting.depth: Fighters on one plane; background crowds and passers-by (locals, a cart, bystanders) give life behind them.

techniques: colour flash on a successful parry or hit
cast shadow ellipse under the feet
one colour key per stage, saturated costumes on top
big text card slam on a red band
feel: colour-keyed stage + big readable silhouette + personal idle + flash on contact + crowd in back = character in every frame
for_fred: Give Fred and Pixie each a signature idle (Fred sways, Pixie stays still and flicks her tail) and a win pose held before Fred exits. Put a small shadow under Fred so he sits in the scene, flash him a colour on surprise, and let one small background character react to what he does.
